section: M1.9 ambience and transcript audio playback
scope: Actual Unreal/host/audio/controller/Windows acceptance; none executed in this source environment.

tests.procedure: Run the retained host without the new playback component.
tests.expected: No new sources; existing mission, transcript, settings and campaign loop work unchanged.

tests.procedure: Add one playback owner with default opt-in false.
tests.expected: No Play or source creation. Visible optional-feature diagnostic; text is not disabled.

tests.procedure: Attempt initialization on a pawn, director or nonlocal controller.
tests.expected: Refuse without creating a source or selecting a replacement owner.

tests.procedure: Add two playback owners to the controller.
tests.expected: UI initializes neither and reports the duplicate; no doubled ambience or radio.

tests.procedure: Enable playback without ready M1.8 routing or with no audio device.
tests.expected: No source starts; there is no uncontrolled full-volume fallback.

tests.procedure: Enable with both sound references empty.
tests.expected: No invented asset or automatic content fetch. Diagnostic leaves transcript usable.

tests.procedure: Assign only a valid owned looping ambience source.
tests.expected: Bed lifecycle works; radio transcript remains silent and completable.

tests.procedure: Assign only a valid owned finite radio source.
tests.expected: No ambience; one transcript playback attempt when text is displayed.

tests.procedure: Assign unplayable audio, a nonlooping bed, looping radio or radio duration outside (0,900].
tests.expected: Reject configuration without mutating source assets or mission state.

tests.procedure: Assign a source without the PlayWhenSilent metadata contract, then test a corrected project-owned wrapper.
tests.expected: First configuration refuses. Corrected source must actually continue through mute in the real host.

tests.procedure: Launch to the native Session menu with both sources valid.
tests.expected: Initialization creates no playing voice. No ambience until active unobstructed gameplay.

tests.procedure: Save Master=0, exit and relaunch; begin a campaign.
tests.expected: No audible full-volume burst. Mix initialized before source Play; confirm with actual audio capture.

tests.procedure: Start a campaign and stand in gameplay for a sustained run.
tests.expected: One local 2D bed, no per-frame play/restart or accumulating audio components.

tests.procedure: Open Pause, settings and journal, then Back through each layer.
tests.expected: Bed pauses once and stays paused until final gameplay return, then resumes rather than restarts.

tests.procedure: Pause the host without opening a Coastal panel, then resume.
tests.expected: Bed remains paused until gameplay is eligible; transcript UI voice follows its explicit UI-pause policy.

tests.procedure: Open radio transcript but prevent a valid painted-body opportunity, then close it.
tests.expected: No voice start for unpresented/canceled text.

tests.procedure: Show a valid transcript and wait a later frame after body paint.
tests.expected: One Radio-class voice starts despite the deliberate modal world pause; bed is paused.

tests.procedure: Let the complete clip finish while transcript remains open.
tests.expected: No replay, journal insertion, mission completion, inventory mutation or auto-close. Continue still requires explicit action.

tests.procedure: Press Continue before the clip finishes, after normal presentation eligibility.
tests.expected: Existing mission acknowledgement executes once; source is stopped and destroyed on close.

tests.procedure: Back out during playback.
tests.expected: Voice stops; no message-heard grant from cancellation or native Stop completion.

tests.procedure: Reinteract with the repaired radio to open a fresh transcript after cancel or completion.
tests.expected: New ticket permits one playback attempt from the beginning. No repeated item consumption or journal duplication.

tests.procedure: Open journal entries including the saved transcript.
tests.expected: Reading the journal does not start the radio voice.

tests.procedure: Set Radio=0 and complete the opening.
tests.expected: Full text and Continue remain available. Mission completion is independent of native sound output.

tests.procedure: Use distinct Master, Ambience and Radio values; mute/unmute.
tests.expected: Retained mix multiplies Master once. Source multipliers stay 1; settings do not respawn clips.

tests.procedure: Change campaign or Continue a save while presentation exists through a controlled native test path.
tests.expected: Old sources stop and stale tickets do not replay in the restored session; bed can begin once for the new epoch.

tests.procedure: Attempt a known invalid load from the session menu with the previous campaign retained.
tests.expected: No silent New. Bed remains paused under the retained modal; no automatic voice start.

tests.procedure: Enter a test hazard, then complete safe return.
tests.expected: Bed pauses during return and resumes after it; inventory, receipts, mission and journal unchanged by audio.

tests.procedure: Inject a terminal recovery failure using disposable saves.
tests.expected: Both sources stop or remain silent; no autonomous replay, save or mission change.

tests.procedure: Instrument a source allocation/registration failure or enforce voice rejection through real concurrency.
tests.expected: No retry loop. Allocation failure is reported; void Play rejection is not misreported as audible success. Text remains usable.

tests.procedure: Release/unregister the routing owner while both presentation paths have been exercised.
tests.expected: Owned voices stop before its mix contribution is popped. Unrelated audio/mixes remain untouched.

tests.procedure: Invalidate the captured device/source or disable UI tick through a controlled fault.
tests.expected: Running playback owner stops and refuses automatic rebind; no campaign writes or fake device recovery.

tests.procedure: Exit/relaunch repeatedly, including while transcript voice plays.
tests.expected: No leaked components, duplicate delegates, extra mix pops or retained sources across worlds.

tests.procedure: Use keyboard/mouse and controller-only at 720p/1080p, 100%/150% text.
tests.expected: Body/Continue still visible and operable; playback does not steal focus or consume input.

tests.procedure: Build/cook/package and launch Windows outside the editor; execute New, pickup, storage round-trip, repair, transcript, safe return, verified save, exit and Continue.
tests.expected: Coherent campaign with actual AGIS/Hyper; actual sources/routing and preferences restore separately. Record real logs and audio observations.
